Modern Woodmen of America is hiring a Software Developer to design, build, and enhance applications that support business operations. The role includes analyzing requirements, developing and testing software, troubleshooting issues, and improving system performance.
Finance
Health Insurance
Financial Services
Life Insurance
No H1B
Responsibilities
Formulate system scope and objectives and modify applications through research
Participate in developing and reviewing business and system requirements for accurate tech solutions
Develop software following established standards and guidelines
Create technical documentation of designed software for quality assurance and production support
Perform unit testing to ensure requirements are met, functionality works, and errors are handled
Perform necessary system analysis and functional testing
Coordinate between departments for smooth procedural implementation
Train users on new or updated systems
Stay updated on system processes and programming methodologies
Qualification
Object-Oriented Programming
Relational Databases

Full-Stack Development
C#

Blazor

Required
Proficiency in object-oriented programming, relational databases, application design principles, documentation, and analysis
Associate degree in a related field
Work Experience; Jr. Software Developer 0-2 years, Software Developer 2+ years, Senior Software Developer 5+ years
Strong verbal and written communication skills, with the ability to effectively collaborate with team members and business partners
A team-oriented mindset with a willingness to actively participate in team initiatives and contribute to shared goals
Proficiency in using email, phone, and collaborations tools to communicate effectively
Adaptability and a willingness to continuously learn and grow in a rapidly evolving technology landscape
Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States without the need for current or future employment-based sponsorship. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of employment visas at this time, nor can we guarantee future sponsorship
Preferred
full-stack developer, C#, JavaScript, Blazor, SQL development
COBOL experience a plus
Benefits
Full-time hybrid position: 37.5 hours per week (7.5 hours per day), Monday-Friday, with flexible start time between 7 a.m.-9 a.m.; hybrid positions work at least four days in office each week. Employees beginning to work in a new hybrid role will be expected to work on-site (five days a week) during the initial training period which may be up to one year. Hybrid work arrangements are subject to change at any time based on business needs.
Vacation, sick leave and 11 paid holidays.
Educational offerings to enhance your knowledge of our industry.
Collaborative work and volunteer opportunities.
Employees can purchase a variety of breakfast, lunch, and beverage options at Café 1883.
Company-paid retirement plan.
Matching 401(k) plan.
Employee Impact Bonus.
Medical, Dental and Prescription Drug Insurance. We pay 100% of employees’ health insurance premiums and 50% of employee dependents’ premiums.
Group term life insurance.
Long-term and short-term disability.
Voluntary benefits: vision, flexible savings accounts (FSA), accident insurance.
